annotations.title: List cars found for a car watch

description: Use this when the user asks what AutoIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same cars AutoIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer matches. Returns at most 20 newest matches with the price and AutoIsto price verdict at the time of the match and a link. Before the user confirms the intent there are no matches. Matches come from listings AutoIsto aggregates from the market, so they cover only cars listed on AutoIsto and may be incomplete; a car may already be sold.

since.description: Only matches found after this ISO time.

name: intent_list_matches

url.description: Link to the car on www.autoisto.sk — show it unchanged.

more.description: More matches exist than returned; call again with since.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the AutoIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = AutoIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

title: List cars found for a car watch
